ticker_news.title: Meta Cuts Manus Free From China, As Regional Lender Gets Premium Bailout
ticker_news.description: Meta is acquiring AI startup Manus for $2-3 billion but explicitly excludes its Chinese operations, reflecting a broader trend of Chinese tech entrepreneurs relocating to Singapore to avoid regulatory scrutiny. Meanwhile, Weihai Bank in Shandong province received a 1 billion yuan government bailout through premium-priced stock purchases, a move designed to boost confidence in the lender rather than follow market logic.
ticker_news.author: Bamboo Works

SPY.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Futures Up, S&P 500 And Nasdaq Slip As ADP Jobs Data Signals Modest Rebound— Mobileye, Penguin Solutions In Focus (UPDATED)
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures were mixed on Wednesday following a strong Tuesday close. ADP reported private-sector job additions of 41,000 in December, signaling modest labor market stabilization. The Dow Jones futures rose 0.04% while S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures declined slightly. Key movers included Mobileye jumping 11% on a $900M robotics acquisition, Ventyx surging 68% on Eli Lilly acquisition talks, and AAR Corp rising 5% on better-than-expected earnings.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
